case.title: The Last Call
case.tagline: One phone call. Forty-three seconds. A locked door.
case.description: Daniel Perera is found dead inside his Colombo apartment at 10:42 PM. The front door appears locked. Three people had contact with him that evening.
case.story: Daniel Perera is found dead inside his apartment at 10:42 PM. The front door appears locked. Three people had contact with Daniel during the evening. The initial investigation finds several inconsistencies. Who killed Daniel? Why? How? What happened between 9:00 PM and 10:42 PM?

victim.name: Daniel Perera
victim.description: Co-founder of Perera & Perera Logistics. Found in his living room with a head wound.

objectives: What happened between 9:00 PM and 10:42 PM?

locations.name: Daniel's Apartment
locations.description: Two-bedroom apartment on the 7th floor. Front door found locked from inside; the parking stairwell door was not.

locations.name: Living Room
locations.description: Where Daniel's body was found. Signs of a short struggle near the coffee table.

locations.name: Kitchen
locations.description: An open wine bottle is missing from the rack; a drawer was left open.

locations.name: Bedroom
locations.description: Daniel's home office desk holds a folder of company bank statements.

locations.name: Apartment Entrance
locations.description: Corridor with a ceiling CCTV camera covering the lift lobby and door 7B.

locations.name: Flower Road Pharmacy
locations.description: 24-hour pharmacy 400m from the building. Receipts are time-stamped.

locations.name: Parking Area
locations.description: Basement car park with a camera on the exit ramp.

locations.name: Michael's Office
locations.address: Perera & Perera Logistics, Union Place, Colombo 02
locations.description: Michael claims he worked here after 9:15 PM. The office door log shows no entry that night.

scenes.name: Living Room — Night of the Incident
scenes.description: Primary crime scene. Daniel lies near the coffee table; a broken glass and his phone are nearby.

hotspots.name: Body
hotspots.initialInfo: Daniel Perera, 34. No pulse. Blunt-force wound to the back of the head.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Lividity suggests death between 10:20 and 10:35 PM. Fragments of green glass in the hair — from a bottle, not a wine glass.

hotspots.name: Phone
hotspots.description: Cracked phone near the rug edge.
hotspots.initialInfo: A cracked smartphone, screen still lit.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Last outgoing call at 10:17 PM to a saved contact: 'S'.

hotspots.name: Wine Glass
hotspots.initialInfo: A broken wine glass on the coffee table. Wine still wet.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Two glasses were poured — only one is here. A partial print is visible on a large shard.

hotspots.name: Coffee Table
hotspots.initialInfo: The table has been shoved about 20 cm from its rug marks.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Scuff marks indicate a struggle. A coaster ring shows a second glass stood here.

hotspots.name: Window
hotspots.initialInfo: Window locked from inside. 7th floor — no external access.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Rules out entry via window. Killer must have used a door.

hotspots.name: Carpet
hotspots.initialInfo: A damp patch near the edge of the rug.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Smells of wine and cleaning solution — someone tried to wipe it. Leads toward the kitchen.

hotspots.name: Sofa
hotspots.initialInfo: A grey throw half-pulled to the floor.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Between the cushions: a business card for 'Wijesinghe & Co. Forensic Auditors' with Monday 9 AM written on it.

scenes.name: Kitchen
scenes.description: Wine rack missing one bottle. An opened drawer and a wiped counter.

hotspots.name: Wine Rack
hotspots.initialInfo: One slot is empty — the bottle on the counter is a different vintage.
hotspots.detailedInfo: The missing bottle matches green glass fragments found on the body.

hotspots.name: Open Drawer
hotspots.initialInfo: Kitchen towels missing from the drawer.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Towels were likely used to clean up the wine spill.

hotspots.name: Counter
hotspots.description: Glass of wine left on counter.
hotspots.initialInfo: A second glass of wine, half-finished.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Moved here from the living room. Lipstick-free rim — the guest was likely male.

scenes.name: 7th Floor Corridor
scenes.description: Lift lobby and apartment door. CCTV camera overhead.

hotspots.name: CCTV Camera
hotspots.initialInfo: A building security camera covering the corridor.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Footage can be requested from building management.

hotspots.name: Door 7B
hotspots.initialInfo: Locked deadbolt, no signs of forced entry.
hotspots.detailedInfo: The deadbolt locks automatically when the door closes. A locked door proves nothing.

hotspots.name: Crumpled Receipt
hotspots.description: Paper scrap by the door mat.
hotspots.initialInfo: A crumpled pharmacy receipt lies near the door mat.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Flower Road Pharmacy, 10:04 PM. Painkillers and a bandage. Someone was in this corridor after the argument.

hotspots.name: Notice Board
hotspots.initialInfo: The building manager has pinned a signed statement to the board.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Nuwan's witness statement describing the shouting match he overheard at 10:21 PM.

hotspots.name: Stairwell
hotspots.description: Leads down to the parking area.
hotspots.initialInfo: Emergency stairwell to basement parking.
hotspots.detailedInfo: No camera inside the stairwell — but the parking exit is covered.

scenes.name: Bedroom
scenes.description: Daniel's bedroom. A desk with a locked drawer, a bed and a wardrobe.

hotspots.name: Desk Drawer
hotspots.description: Desk drawer with a brass handle.
hotspots.initialInfo: The drawer is stuffed with ledgers and printed statements.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Daniel's business records: payments to an account controlled by Michael, dated over eight months.

hotspots.name: Bed
hotspots.initialInfo: The bed is unmade. Daniel hadn't slept here tonight.
hotspots.detailedInfo: A phone charger is plugged in beside the bed, but no phone. It was found in the living room.

hotspots.name: Wardrobe
hotspots.initialInfo: Suits hang neatly. Nothing out of place.
hotspots.detailedInfo: A gym bag at the bottom contains a spare phone SIM and a contact list backup.

hotspots.name: Nightstand
hotspots.initialInfo: A lamp, a glass of water and a paperback.
hotspots.detailedInfo: The paperback's receipt marks the page: bought last week. Nothing connected to the case.

scenes.name: Flower Road Pharmacy
scenes.description: 24-hour pharmacy on Flower Road. The night pharmacist remembers faces.

hotspots.name: Pharmacy Counter
hotspots.initialInfo: The pharmacist confirms a man bought painkillers and a bandage at 10:04 PM.
hotspots.detailedInfo: He paid cash and kept his left hand wrapped in a cloth. That matches the receipt found in the corridor.

hotspots.name: Receipt Printer
hotspots.initialInfo: The till logs every sale with a timestamp.
hotspots.detailedInfo: The log shows the 10:04 PM sale, one of only three that night.

hotspots.name: Medicine Shelf
hotspots.initialInfo: Rows of over-the-counter medicine.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Nothing here relates to the case.

scenes.name: Basement Parking B1
scenes.description: Basement parking of Green View Apartments. One camera covers the exit ramp.

hotspots.name: Parking Camera
hotspots.initialInfo: A camera with a red recording light covers the exit ramp.
hotspots.detailedInfo: Footage shows a black saloon, plate CAB-4471, leaving at 10:33 PM.

hotspots.name: Black Saloon
hotspots.initialInfo: A black saloon is parked in Michael's usual bay.
hotspots.detailedInfo: The bonnet is still warm. Michael's car was driven recently.

hotspots.name: Exit Ramp
hotspots.initialInfo: The ramp leads to the street.
hotspots.detailedInfo: A barrier logs every plate. The log is held by building management.

scenes.name: Michael's Office
scenes.description: Michael's office at Perera & Perera Logistics. He claims he worked here after 9:15 PM.

hotspots.name: Door Access Log
hotspots.initialInfo: The access log shows every badge swipe.
hotspots.detailedInfo: No swipe for Michael after 6:40 PM that night. His alibi is not supported.

hotspots.name: Desk & Monitor
hotspots.initialInfo: The monitor is off and the keyboard is cold.
hotspots.detailedInfo: The desk calendar has the evening of the incident circled, with no meeting listed.

suspects.name: Sarah Fernando
suspects.publicInfo: Relationship with Daniel ended three months ago. Remained in occasional contact.
suspects.claim: She was home in Rajagiriya between 9:30 PM and 11:00 PM and did not speak to Daniel that night.
hiddenInfo: She called Daniel at 10:17 PM — a 43-second call.
She initially lies about the call to avoid being implicated.
She had been helping Daniel collect proof of Michael's embezzlement.
She met Daniel briefly at 7:30 PM to hand over bank statements.
suspects.motive: Possible jealousy over the breakup (red herring).
suspects.personality: Guarded, articulate, becomes defensive when pressed on timing.

suspects.name: Michael Perera
suspects.publicInfo: Co-owner of the logistics firm. Visited Daniel earlier in the evening to discuss quarterly accounts.
suspects.claim: He left Daniel's apartment at 9:15 PM and drove straight to his office.
hiddenInfo: Building CCTV shows him re-entering the lobby at 9:42 PM.
Daniel had discovered LKR 18.4M missing from company accounts.
Daniel planned to go to the auditors on Monday.
His fingerprint is on the wine bottle neck and glass shard.
suspects.motive: Financial dispute — Daniel was about to expose his embezzlement.
suspects.personality: Calm, confident, overly precise about times. Cracks when confronted with CCTV.

suspects.name: Nuwan Silva
suspects.publicInfo: Lives across the corridor. Works evening shifts for a food delivery app.
suspects.claim: He was working deliveries nearby all evening.
hiddenInfo: He heard a loud argument from 7B at about 10:21 PM.
He saw a man in a dark jacket leave via the parking stairwell around 10:31 PM.
He bought painkillers at Flower Road Pharmacy at 10:04 PM — he was briefly home.
suspects.personality: Nervous around police, honest once reassured.

documents.title: Initial Police Report
documents.body: Officers responded to 7B Green View Apartments at 10:48 PM following a call from building security. Victim Daniel Perera found deceased in the living room. Front door locked. No forced entry.

documents.title: Nuwan Silva — Signed Statement
documents.body: I heard shouting at around 10:20. Two men. One said 'you'll ruin me'. Ten minutes later I saw a man in a dark jacket going down the stairs.

documents.title: Auditor Appointment Email
documents.body: Dear Mr. Perera, confirming your meeting with our forensic accounting team on Monday at 9:00 AM.

interviews.title: Sarah Fernando — Ex-partner
interviews.description: Sarah denies contact. Phone evidence exposes the 10:17 PM call and reveals Daniel's private matter.

nodes.text: Interview begins — Sarah Fernando, Cinnamon Gardens police station.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I've already told the police everything. I was home that night.
Choose a question

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: Where were you at 10 PM?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: At home in Rajagiriya. Watching a series. Alone.

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: What was your relationship with Daniel?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: We dated for two years. It ended three months ago. We were still… civil.

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: When did you last speak to Daniel?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Last week, maybe. I don't remember exactly.

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: Did Daniel mention any trouble at work?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: He was stressed about the company accounts. He wouldn't say more — he never liked bringing work home.

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: Did you call Daniel at 10:17 PM?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: No. Why would I call him that late?
Present: Daniel's Phone — call log 10:17 PM, 43 seconds

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: ...Fine. I did call him.
Clue: Sarah lied about the 10:17 PM call

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: Why did you call him?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: He sounded scared at dinner. He said Michael had been taking money. I gave him the bank statements at 7:30. I called to check he was okay — he said 'Michael is here' and hung up.
Unlock: Sarah met Daniel earlier that evening + Michael interview Q: 'Were you there at 10:17?'
Interview complete

interviews.title: Michael Perera — Business Partner
interviews.description: Michael's 9:15 PM alibi collapses against the CCTV footage.

nodes.text: Interview begins — Michael Perera.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Terrible business. Daniel was like a brother. Ask whatever you need.
Choose a question

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: When did you leave Daniel's apartment?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: 9:15 sharp. I drove to the office to finish the quarterly report.

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: How was the business doing?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Never better. Daniel worried too much about the numbers.

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: Did you and Daniel argue that evening?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: A disagreement about the audit, nothing more. We always sorted things out over a drink.

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: Were you with Daniel at 10:17 PM?
Present: Building CCTV — 9:42 PM re-entry

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That could be anyone. ...Alright. I went back for my laptop charger. He was alive when I left.
Clue: Michael's alibi broken
Unlock: Parking Area
Interview complete

interviews.title: Nuwan Silva — Neighbor
interviews.description: Nuwan's receipt proves he was home; he heard the argument.

nodes.text: Interview begins — Nuwan Silva, Apt 7C.

nodes.speaker: Nuwan
nodes.text: I was out working, sir. Deliveries all night.
Choose a question

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: How well did you know Daniel?

nodes.speaker: Nuwan
nodes.text: Only to nod hello in the corridor. He seemed a decent man, always tipped me at Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: Tell me about your night, start to finish.

nodes.speaker: Nuwan
nodes.text: Shift started at six. Orders across Colombo 7. I… did not get home until late, that is all.
Present: Pharmacy Receipt — 10:04 PM

nodes.speaker: Nuwan
nodes.text: Okay, okay. I came home at ten for a headache. I heard them. Shouting about money, around 10:21.
Clue: Argument at 10:21 PM

nodes.speaker: Detective
nodes.text: Did you see anyone leave?

nodes.speaker: Nuwan
nodes.text: A man in a dark jacket, down the parking stairs. Maybe 10:30.
Interview complete

Who did Daniel contact shortly before his death?

solution.method: Struck with a wine bottle during an argument
solution.explanation: Michael returned at 9:42 PM after Daniel threatened to go to the auditors. When Daniel's call to Sarah revealed he was not alone, the argument escalated. Michael struck him with the wine bottle, cleaned the spill, and left via the parking stairwell at 10:31 PM.

reveal.title: The blow
reveal.text: Michael attacks Daniel with the wine bottle.
